text.en: Oh, you're awake. Don't be scared. I'm feifei. I found you in the Chaos Mist and carried you back to Mirage Inn.
text.zh: 你醒啦。别怕，我叫腓腓。是我在混沌迷雾里发现了你，把你背回蜃影客栈的。

text.en: When I carried you in, the inn opened its gate and this room by itself. The first light in the formation even flickered. The inn has already chosen you as its owner.
text.zh: 我背你回来的时候，客栈自己开了大门，这间房也自己开了。阵法里的第一点光还亮了一下。客栈已经认你为主人了。

text.en: I don't know why. It has never done that for anyone I know.
text.zh: 我也不知道为什么。至少我认识的人里，它从没这样过。

text.en: You're an outsider. I've been outside, so I can speak your language. What's your name?
text.zh: 看你的样子，是个外来者吧？我去过外面的世界，所以会你们的语言。你叫什么名字？

text.en: Good, {player_source_name} is a good name. But people around Mist Island speak in a special language: {special_language_name}. You need a {special_language_name} name too. What {special_language_name} name would you like? Or I can choose one for you.
text.zh: 好的，{player_source_name} 是个好名字。不过迷雾岛周围的人们都说一种特殊的语言，叫{special_language_name}。你需要有一个{special_language_name}名字。你可以告诉我你想要的{special_language_name}名字吗？或者我帮你取一个。

text.en: {player_display_name}! That's your new name now. I'll call you that.
text.zh: {player_display_name}！从现在起这就是你的新名字啦，我就这么叫你。

text.en: No problem. Then tell me the {special_language_name} name you want, and I'll use it.
text.zh: 没问题。那你说一个你想要的{special_language_name}名字，我就用那个。

text.en: {player_display_name} sounds wonderful. You must be wondering where this is.
text.zh: {player_display_name}，听起来很棒。我想你应该很好奇这是什么地方。

text.en: Glad to hear that! Let me tell you where we are.
text.zh: 太好了！让我告诉你，我们现在在哪里。

text.en: Let me show you what I saw out there. This place is called Mist Island. Long ago, it was connected to the outside world. Then the Chaos Mist appeared. It covered the surrounding lands and cut off communication between everyone.
text.zh: 我给你看看外面的世界。这里叫做——迷雾岛。很久以前，这里和外面的世界连接在一起。可是不知道什么时候开始，这些混沌迷雾出现了，它覆盖了周围的大陆，也阻断了大家之间的交流。

text.en: Look. Six lights, six continents. Legend says six artifacts protect this world. But all of them disappeared, and the power guarding Mist Island is growing weaker.
text.zh: 你看。六道光，就是六块大陆。传说中，保护这个世界的力量来自六件神器。可是它们全都不见了……守护迷雾岛的力量，也越来越弱。

text.en: You are inside Mirage Inn right now. It is the reason this place has no mist. Deep inside is a formation powered by the six artifacts, but the artifacts are lost, and the formation is slowly losing its power.
text.zh: 你现在就在蜃影客栈里。这里就是这一带没有迷雾的原因。客栈深处有一座阵法，能量来自六件神器；可是神器遗失了，阵法也在慢慢变弱。

text.en: The inn chose you before you even opened your eyes. We will find out why together.
text.zh: 你还没睁开眼，客栈就认了你。为什么——我们一起把它找出来。
